newsitem.title: FINLAND: ELCOTEQ SAYS MULLS IPO AND BOURSE LISTING.
newsitem.headline: ELCOTEQ SAYS MULLS IPO AND BOURSE LISTING.

text.p: Finnish electronics group Elcoteq Network Oy said on Wednesday it was considering an initial public offering and a bourse listing.
Elcoteq said in a statement it had chosen Union Bank of Switzerland and Finnish Mandatum Securities Oy to advise it on the prospects for an IPO and a listing of its shares.
"No decisions on a listing or a timetable for it have been made," Elcoteq said.
Elcoteq makes electronic parts and end products for companies operating in information technology, manufacturing and the computer and consumer electronics industries, it said.
"Group net sales are expected to exceed 1.5 billion markka in 1997," it said, adding that exports account for 70 percent of sales.
The company has 2,550 employees, 900 in Finland and 1,650 in Estonia, it said.
